description.name: Attach Fire with Stacking
description.text: Increase Attach Fire Level by 1 and increase Max Attach Element Level by 2, up to Attach Fire 3

description.name: Arcane Dyad Empowered: Braska
description.text: Keeps track of the number of uses of Apex Ifrit (0~2), removed after using Apex Ifrit two times

description.name: Apex Ifrit Damage Tracker
description.text: Increases Apex Ifrit level by 1 after dealing 100001 or 300001 total damage during the status, removed if the character hasn't [Arcane Dyad Empowered: Braska]

description.name: Apex Ifrit Level
description.text: Keeps track of Apex Ifrit level (0~2), removed if the character hasn't [Arcane Dyad Empowered: Braska]
